current.scope: Measurement cgroup and descendants: preparation, controller, private service and all sandboxes.
current.mean_method: Previous sample held until next sample; first-to-last sample only, including recorded gaps. Estimate, not a continuous integral.
current.interpretation: Charged group memory, not complete sandbox physical memory. Before-guest baseline includes prepared inputs and service; increases include subsequent control and service work. Peaks are sampled, final sample may be after guest deletion.
current.components: anon/file/kernel explain current; shmem is part of file. Counters are sequential and may lag: do not add them to current or label their residual unaccounted memory.
